questions.question: Why is a web crawl snapshot not yet a training dataset?
options: It still needs permission, extraction, quality, privacy, deduplication, contamination, mixture, and lineage decisions
It contains no machine-readable content
It cannot be stored in object storage
It must be converted into labeled classification examples first
questions.explanation: Collection only establishes an upstream source. A training corpus is the versioned result of governance and curation decisions.

questions.question: What is the safest default disposition when a record has an unknown license or broken provenance?
options: Publish it because the text looks useful
Quarantine it with a reason code until policy resolves the uncertainty
Delete the source metadata and continue
Assign the average license of the rest of the corpus
questions.explanation: Unknown eligibility is not evidence of permission. Quarantine preserves the record and decision context without silently publishing it.

questions.question: What is the core invariant of a curated demonstration dataset?
options: Every accepted example teaches intended behavior, has auditable provenance, and fills a measured need
Every example is generated by the same model
The release contains as many rows as possible
One aggregate quality score is above 80
questions.explanation: A useful release connects every row to an intended behavior, evidence chain, and coverage requirement; raw volume cannot replace those properties.

questions.question: What is the core evidence invariant for an extracted field?
options: Keep the value linked to its source, schema version, and decision state
Keep only the normalized value after validation
Use the same confidence threshold for every field
Delete intermediate versions after each retry
questions.explanation: Source evidence, contract version, and decision history make a field inspectable, replayable, and safe to correct.

questions.question: What is the central output invariant of a production layout-analysis stage?
options: Every region remains traceable to page coordinates, model evidence, and the source page
Every page produces exactly five regions
OCR text replaces all page geometry
The highest model confidence is treated as ground truth
questions.explanation: Coordinates, labels, scores, versions, and source identity make region decisions inspectable and replayable.

questions.question: What is Dedoc's core purpose?
options: Generate documents from prompts
Convert different document formats into a unified structured representation
Store PDF bytes as database rows
Replace every downstream search engine
questions.explanation: Dedoc extracts content, annotations, structure, tables, attachments, and metadata into a common output representation.
